title: Square’s new kiosk lets you talk to AI for help with your order
slides: Square's new kiosk: talk to AI for order help?
The AI actually understands your spoken request.
But it guides you to buy more items.
Customers can order faster, but may spend more.
Next time you see one, try asking for a combo.
thread_text:
1. AI Orders Talk Back

Square's new kiosk lets you speak your order, but the AI may nudge you to add extra items.

2. It Hears You Right

The system understands spoken requests, so there's no typing or tapping required.

3. The Upsell Trap

After taking your order, the AI suggests more items, which can inflate your total.

4. Speed vs. Spending

You'll order faster, but the extra suggestions might make you spend more than planned.

5. Try It Yourself

Next time you see one, ask for a combo and see if you get upsold.
